purpose: Teach: 前置き/受け取ら/訊い/知らず/さらっ/今時/騒ぐ/めくっ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前の話、前置き長いんだよ
lines.en: Riku, you always drag out your preamble so much.
lines.style: Dry, teasing lob from across the room. Light and pointed — not mean, just calling him out the way friends do. Slight lilt at the end, like she's almost amused at his own expense.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、テストの結果、ちゃんと受け取らせてもらってるか?桜
lines.en: Did you actually get your test results back properly?
lines.style: Genuine question underneath the surface — softening at the end. Not accusatory, more like he's checking in. Quiet attention that doesn't announce itself.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、先生に質問訊いてみろよ
lines.en: Why don't you just ask the teacher about it?
lines.style: Straightforward suggestion. Matter-of-fact delivery — not unkind, just the direct route. The kind of thing she says because it's practical, not because she's being difficult.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、知らずに勉強会の日程変わってたぞ、桜
lines.en: The study group schedule actually changed and nobody told you.
lines.style: Quiet realization delivered at conversational pace. Slight concern underneath — he's noticing something she missed. Not lecturing, just pointing out what slipped past.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、さらっと宿題やってんな
lines.en: You're just breezing through your homework like it's nothing.
lines.style: Light approval. Half-admiration, half-commentary — noticing something good without making a show of it. Slight smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、今時のアニメ詳しいよな、桜
lines.en: You really know your stuff about modern anime, don't you?
lines.style: Genuine compliment delivered softly. Not teasing this time — actual recognition of something she's into. Warm, direct eye-contact level.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、教室で騒ぐなよ
lines.en: Don't make so much noise in class, okay?
lines.style: Quiet directive. Not harsh — just the practical boundary of someone who cares enough to say it. Delivered like a friend giving a heads-up, not a warning.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、漫画めくって時間つぶしてんだろ?桜
lines.en: You're just flipping through manga to kill time, aren't you?
lines.style: Wry observation delivered with a tiny smile in the voice. Caught him red-handed but not bothering to make a thing of it. Light, knowing.
